name: Heating, Ventilating and Air-Conditioning (HVAC) Technologies
description: This course will focus on in-depth learning and application of engineering concepts involved in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems with a focus on cooling/heating load and component design calculations, systems-level analysis, equipment selection, and instrumentation and control strategies. The course will enable students to develop deep technical expertise required in developing next-generation thermal energy systems for the built environment.
